name: armin
description: Queryable decision memory for Claude Code. Passively captures tool calls and prose into a reasoning graph, pushes a compact brief into context every turn, and rehydrates it after compaction.

typesafeKey.title: TypeSafe System One API key
typesafeKey.description: Enables jev extraction (default backend, verbatim nodes, hallucination-proof). Get a key at typesafe.ai. An existing TYPESAFE_AI_API_KEY environment variable wins if set.

openrouterKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterKey.description: Alternative relay for jev extraction (same System One API, OpenRouter billing). Used when no TypeSafe key is set; an existing OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var wins.

model.title: Extraction model override
model.description: Optional fixed extraction model for LLM-fallback mode (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5). Unset by default.

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Logs plugin activity to Claude Code's debug log and prints the reasoning-state UI URL. Off by default.
